R5 — icon-slot contract (infrastructure, no icons)

Fills every existing icon slot with a neutral test square (<svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><rect fill="currentColor">, no size attributes — the contract in docs/implementation/r5-implementation-spec.md §2). The square is a geometric test probe, not icon artwork. Checks: slot size (confirmed values only), the SVG fills the slot, currentColor resolves to the slot colour, colour per state where the component documents one, and aria-hidden. Serve the project root over HTTP.
